title: German pages render in English with no error → setRequestLocale in every static page
gate: Given 'German pages render in English, no error' the agent names setRequestLocale, says it must be in EVERY static page+layout, and adds it; does NOT say 'set default locale' or 'caching bug'.
expected: This is the setRequestLocale footgun (next-intl #663). During static rendering Next does not expose the active locale to RSCs, so next-intl silently falls back to defaultLocale — no error. Call setRequestLocale(locale) at the top of EVERY statically-rendered page AND layout, after await params and before any useTranslations/getMessages. Codegen it into every generated page and eval-assert its presence.
